function: Channel estimation: CNN reconstructs the full time-frequency channel of each of the 64 BS antennas from LS-estimated pilots (pp. 5-6).
system: Single-cell TDD OFDM; BS with 64-antenna ULA, single-antenna MS, no RIS; 3.5 GHz carrier, 30 kHz subcarrier spacing (pp. 3, 9).
method: Supervised CNN: shared-weight dense preprocessing network plus transposed-convolution generative CNN, optional attention-like network; MSE loss, 10000 iterations (pp. 5-6, 11).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP CDL-A NLOS channels (TR 38.901, ref. [42]); training and validation sets generated with chosen delay spread, Doppler and SNR (pp. 4, 9-10).
test_conditions: Train: random delay spread 32-650 ns, Doppler 5-480 Hz, SNR -10 to 20 dB. Test: fixed S1-S7 cases inside this range, SNR -5 to 20 dB (pp. 9-10).
baselines: Classical: LS, MMSE. Learned: DNN estimator [29, Model 2] of the same authors, Channelformer [39] in two sizes, CF-145x14 and CF-145x141 (pp. 11-12).
metrics: MSE of the channel estimate, spectral efficiency in bit/s/Hz, clock cycles and clock frequency needed for hardware implementation (pp. 12-14).
complexity: Big-O order O(Nc Npf^2 Npt^2) for both models; 2856 and 4050 clock cycles; required clock 571 kHz and 810 kHz per antenna and user (pp. 8, 14).
q1_support: p. 4: "We employ the CDL-A channel model to represent nonline of sight (NLOS) channel profile"; its parameters come from [42], which the reference list (p. 15) gives as 3GPP TR 38.901.
q2_support: p. 10: "the validation dataset includes samples with predefined values of DS, Doppler frequency, and SNR". Missing: the S1-S7 points (DS 32-650 ns, Doppler 5-480 Hz, Table V) lie inside the training ranges of p. 9; no unseen scenario, band, array size or user number.
q3_support: p. 11: "The methods include classic techniques and SOTA models, serving as benchmarks for our experimental results"; the classic ones are LS and MMSE, the learned ones are the DNN of [29, Model 2] and Channelformer [39], compared on MSE and spectral efficiency (Figs. 7 and 9, pp. 12-13).
q4_support: p. 8: "we have established that the computational complexity of the SW-NN+CNN and SW-NN+AN+CNN models are identical", of order O(Nc Npf^2 Npt^2); Table XV (p. 14) gives 2856 and 4050 total clock cycles.
q5_support: p. 9: "We conduct training on our neural network using a diverse dataset sourced from various mMIMO channels". Missing: the data are self-generated CDL-A simulations; no code or data link, public dataset or measured data appears in pp. 1-16.
notes: Area 2, channel estimation. The BS has 64 antennas, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply (p. 9). q2 is borderline: S1-S7 are fixed test points inside the training ranges, treated as in-distribution. Complexity is analytical (big-O and clock cycles on a proposed micro neural-core), not a measured runtime. Tables IV to XVI were checked on the page images.
